mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_principal_status_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, principal_id, action) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{principal}, #{action}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_principal_status_receipts SET changed = #{changed} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND changed IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, principal_id, action, changed FROM nw_principal_status_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
